candidates.title: SeqMoE: Toward Full-Load Performance via Predictive and Graph-Compatible MoE Offloading
candidates.reason: Recent MoE offloading system combining sequence-to-sequence expert prediction, deadline-aware joint prefetch scheduling, forecast-driven Belady-style caching, and a graph-compatible runtime. Primary arXiv reports 96.97% expert hit rate and 80.22% of full-load performance at 45% expert residency; directly relevant to expert cache/prefetch/offload research.
